stories.headline: Andreessen on the "greengrocer lie" — why we chant slogans we know are false
stories.body: Marc Andreessen on preference falsification: the 1985 Prague greengrocer parable, back again.
stories.notes: Andreessen unpacking Timur Kuran’s "Private Truths, Public Lies" + Václav Havel’s greengrocer parable. No speculation — maps directly onto modern forced public compliance.
